title: AI-Powered Chatbot for Disaster Response
summary: The Ethiopian Red Cross and meteorological partners propose a disaster chatbot, with humanitarian deployment pilots planned.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The chatbot is intended to provide emergency guidance, local-language information, and referrals to assistance. The source lists future work on language support, datasets, and pilots. Completed emergency responses and individual benefits remain undocumented.
purpose: Make disaster guidance and assistance information easier to access.

ratings.reason: The Ethiopian disaster chatbot has a planned humanitarian pilot, not a documented response improvement.
No resident is shown to have received an effective emergency intervention.
Preparedness and reduced climate-disaster impact are prospective.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 23: AI-Powered Chatbot for Disaster Response

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: An Ethiopian chatbot proposal supports disaster assistance
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
